description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'Unit' entities within a project, including actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting units, and managing unit conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Unit
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing units and their conversions within a project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Lists units, their usage status, and conversions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a unit by ID and stores it in the stash.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific unit, including conversions and related articles.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new unit and proceeds to update or insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Triggers update or insert of a unit.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating or inserting a unit, including validation.

methods.name: add_conversion
methods.description: Adds a new conversion between units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate page after an operation.
